Kharif Sowing Declines Amidst Weak Monsoon and El Niño Concerns

Kharif crop sowing has seen a significant drop, with reports indicating a fall of around 23% due to a weak monsoon and the threat of El Niño. This has led to reduced planting of key crops like rice, cotton, and soybean. Farmers are facing challenges, and some regions are experiencing substantial rainfall deficits, prompting discussions about alternative crops and government advisories.
